definitions.gloss: letter of resignation (formal request to resign)
definitions.explanation: A formal document submitted to request resignation. Phrased as a request (not a declaration), it can be withdrawn before the employer accepts it.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}に{退職願|たいしょくねがい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I submitted my letter of resignation to my supervisor.

examples.japanese: {退職願|たいしょくねがい}は{白|しろ}い{封筒|ふうとう}に{入|い}れて{渡|わた}すのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common to deliver a letter of resignation in a white envelope.

examples.japanese: {退職願|たいしょくねがい}は{受理|じゅり}される{前|まえ}なら{撤回|てっかい}することができる。
examples.english: A resignation request can be withdrawn before it is accepted.

notes:
Literally 'resignation request'. The {願|ねがい} (request) framing makes it a petition, not a unilateral statement — so it can be withdrawn if the employer has not yet accepted it. This distinguishes it from {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}: notice of resignation — a unilateral declaration that takes effect after submission; cannot be withdrawn
- {辞表|じひょう}: resignation letter — used for executives and public officials; more formal/serious

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}を{出|だ}す: to submit a letter of resignation
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a letter of resignation (formal)
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}を{書|か}く: to write a letter of resignation
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}を{撤回|てっかい}する: to withdraw a resignation request
